note: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd (NSE MOTHERSON, BSE 517334). All 8 calls in the window had exchange-filed transcripts (NSE/BSE), each opened via web fetch; direct PDF download was blocked by network proxy, so quotes are verbatim fragments returned by targeted extraction (long sentences elided with '...'), and some page numbers may be +/-1. Q1 FY26 quotes are from the company-website copy of the transcript (NSE filed copy dated 2025-08-20 identical filing, not separately opened). Outcomes from company investor presentations, results filings, transcripts and exchange disclosures as cited; slide numbers approximate. De-duplication per rule 7 (v1.2): each promise graded once at its earliest opened statement; restatements, revisions and moved dates sit in that item's note. Anchored qualitative statements converted to the figure in force when said. No class-10 assurance contradicted on a SEVERE issue (backbone §4 test: permanent capital impairment / loss of revenue stream / unreliable numbers): no override applied. Recurring weakness: Europe restructuring 'mostly done' assurances contradicted (Nov 2024, Aug 2025 restated Nov 2025); consumer-electronics large plant (GF3) slipped from ~May 2026 to Q3 FY27; India aerospace plants slipped from H2 FY25 to Q4 FY27. Engine: map grade -> score. Rule 6: no class-10 item is a Reg. 30 statutory impact line; none removed. v1.2 rule-7 re-grade: added outside_window Q1 FY25, Q4 FY24, Investor Meet 2022; FY25 capex, FY25 leverage, 2.5x policy, India aerospace plants, FY25 WC moved to origin; in-window restatements merged (GF3, greenfields, Yutaka, Nexans, FY26 leverage, M&P, Europe, tariff); Yutaka graded as unreasoned cut (0); score_10 missing (8-entry calc 7.6) -> 7.3.
